title: Fix missing admin panel backend methods (create list, app event, set access key, upload music)

requirements.summary: Wire the frontend AdminComments view to call the existing createCommentList backend method so that creating a new list no longer returns 'backend does not support'.
acceptanceCriteria: Calling the create-list method from the admin panel stores the new list in the backend without error.
No 'backend does not support' error appears when submitting the create list form.
The newly created list appears in subsequent list fetch queries.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query mutation hook useCreateCommentList that calls actor.createCommentList(list) and invalidates the 'commentLists' query key on success. Ensure error handling displays meaningful feedback to the user.

Replace any placeholder or unsupported create-list logic with a call to the useCreateCommentList mutation hook. Wire the create list form submission to invoke the mutation, handle loading states, and display success or error feedback. Ensure the newly created list appears in the list after the query is invalidated.

requirements.summary: Wire the frontend AdminLiveList view to call the existing createAppEvent backend method so that creating an app event no longer returns 'backend does not support'.
acceptanceCriteria: Calling the app event method from the admin panel stores the event without error.
No 'backend does not support' error appears when creating an app event.
Created events are retrievable from the backend in subsequent queries.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query mutation hook useCreateAppEvent that calls actor.createAppEvent(appName, event) and invalidates the 'appEvents' query key on success. Ensure error handling displays meaningful feedback to the user.

Replace any placeholder or unsupported app event creation logic with a call to the useCreateAppEvent mutation hook. Wire the app event form submission to invoke the mutation, handle loading states, and display success or error feedback. Ensure created events appear in the list after the query is invalidated.

requirements.summary: Wire the frontend AdminSettings view to call the existing setAccessKey backend method so that setting the access key no longer returns 'backend does not support'.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting a new access key from AdminSettings persists it in the backend without error.
No 'backend does not support' error appears when calling set access key.
The stored access key can be retrieved and is used for subsequent key-gated operations.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query mutation hook useSetAccessKey that calls actor.setAccessKey(key) and invalidates the 'settings' query key on success. Ensure error handling displays meaningful feedback to the user.

Replace any placeholder or unsupported set-access-key logic with a call to the useSetAccessKey mutation hook. Wire the access key form submission to invoke the mutation, handle loading states, and display success or error feedback. Ensure the updated key is reflected in subsequent settings queries.

requirements.summary: Wire the frontend AdminSettings background music upload to call the existing uploadMusicFile backend method using the blob-storage component so that uploading music no longer returns 'backend does not support'.
acceptanceCriteria: Uploading music from the admin panel stores the music data/URL in the backend without error.
No 'backend does not support' error appears when uploading music.
The stored music URL/data is returned by the background music settings query and plays correctly in the frontend.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query mutation hook useUploadMusicFile that accepts a File, converts it to an ExternalBlob using ExternalBlob.fromBytes, optionally tracks upload progress via withUploadProgress, calls actor.uploadMusicFile(blob), and invalidates the 'settings' and 'publicSettings' query keys on success. Ensure error handling displays meaningful feedback to the user. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace any placeholder or unsupported music upload logic with a call to the useUploadMusicFile mutation hook. Wire the file input and upload button to invoke the mutation, display upload progress (if available), handle loading states, and show success or error feedback. Ensure the uploaded music file is reflected in subsequent settings queries and plays correctly via the useBackgroundMusic hook.
